keyFinding: Criterion-referenced rubrics and immediate formative feedback turn assessment into an active editing loop.

sections.title: Formative assessment and feedback practices
content: In secondary English and journalism instruction, ongoing formative checks allow the teacher to diagnose misconceptions in diction and structure before final grading. [See also: Episode 04 — Teaching and learning process]

sections.title: Non-traditional assessment matrix and performance tasks
content: Performance tasks require students to apply language and journalism conventions in authentic writing outputs evaluated against explicit rubric criteria.
